name: designly
description: Designly is a commercial Art Direction & Design Neural Mesh plugin featuring 13 specialized Skills, 8 custom Codex agents, Taste Engine, Reference Memory, typography & Arabic RTL direction, and targeted Visual QA.

interface.longDescription: Designly v4.0.0 transforms commercial art direction into a Design Neural Mesh of 13 modular Skills and 8 custom Codex agents led by Designly Director. It enforces typed signal contracts (DesignContext, DesignSignalPacket, DesignLock, RevisionRequest), resolves conflicting constraints across brand rules and taste preferences via strict 11-level Signal Priority, provides local-first Reference Memory with stable REF IDs, preflights typography and native Arabic RTL visual architecture, and executes targeted revision loops via independent Visual QA.
defaultPrompt: Art-direct this campaign brief end-to-end with specialist agents and lock enforcement.
Extract evidence-backed transferable taste rules and save with a stable REF ID.
Review this visual with category floors and route targeted revisions to the failing node.
